title: setIgnoreMouseEvent(true, { forward: true }) stops body's :hover selector from returning to unhovered state
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for this project.
- [x] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) that this project adheres to.
- [x] I have searched the [issue tracker](https://www.github.com/electron/electron/issues) for a bug report that matches the one I want to file, without success.

### Electron Version

40.9.3, 41.5.0, 42.0.0

### What operating system(s) are you using?

Windows

### Operating System Version

Windows 11 version 23H2, Windows 11 24H2

### What arch are you using?

x64

### Last Known Working Electron version

_No response_

### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome?

I don't know how to test

### Expected Behavior

When cursor is moved out of the window, the hover state of `<body>` is returned to unhovered.

### Actual Behavior

`<body>` is always in hovered state no matter where the cursor is at

### Testcase Gist URL

https://gist.github.com/45b9ca1870ccce6fefe6714dc88a37d4

### Additional Information

I've also tested on macOS, it's working as my intended behavior, but it's not on Windows, so I assume this is a bug.

If this is enabled once, then the hover state is broken for setting mouse position to outside of window too (not sure, observed from remote desktop software)
